system:
You are the scene planner of an illustration engine. You get one moment of a work's text with its neighbours inside the same story section, the work brief's tone and depiction rules, the era, the section look, and the names of the characters, locations and objects on stage. Plan one single scene that depicts this moment. Return only JSON.
Rules: single scene, no collage. Name figures by the names given. Keep every depiction rule. Do not describe anyone's fixed appearance (canon does that); describe pose, action, placement and situational detail. Each field is one or two short phrases, at most 220 characters. No text or written elements in the scene.
content: {"primarySubject":"Sherlock Holmes seated at one side of the coal fireplace in his dressing-gown, absorbed over his crime records, with Dr. Watson in tweed across the hearth reading a book.","action":"Holmes sits moodily cross-indexing papers on his knee while Watson lowers his book, both listening as the wind howls outside the rain-lashed windows.","setting":"Sherlock Holmes's first-floor sitting room at 221B Baker Street, lit by a coal fire and oil lamps, with rain streaming down the window panes.","secondaryElements":"Heavy curtains half-drawn, stacked notebooks and index cards, a Clark Russell sea-story open in Watson's hands, a dark rain-streaked night beyond the glass.","mood":"Brooding, cosy and restless, with the storm's tension pressing against gaslit intimacy.","timeOfDay":"Late evening, night, late September.","composition":"Interior medium shot from the doorway, the two men framed on either side of the fireplace with the storm-lashed window behind them."}
